reason: This text is the creation and fall narrative from Genesis 2-3, concerning primordial humanity (Adam and Eve) and their relationship with God. It does not address leadership accountability at all. There are no political, religious, or community leaders mentioned, nor is there any discussion of 'the Hebrew people' as a collective entity. The only accountability shown is God holding Adam and Eve personally responsible for their disobedience to His command. The statement presupposes a context of leadership governance over a people group, which is entirely absent from this primordial creation narrative.
